title: saves a trigger-only workflow as a draft and shows the Draft tag in the list

title: promotes a saved draft into a published workflow
verifies: publishing a completed draft drops the Draft tag and adds the pause/resume action

title: opens the editor when a draft row is clicked
verifies: a draft row click routes to the editor, not the read-only Runs view

title: blocks publishing a draft with an incomplete node
verifies: publish is rejected with 'Finish configuring all steps before publishing' while a node is set up later

title: deletes a draft
verifies: the list delete action removes a draft row

title: disables a node and shows the Disabled badge
verifies: muting a node paints the Disabled badge on its card

title: prompts before leaving the editor with unsaved changes
verifies: the Unsaved Changes dialog appears and Discard navigates away

title: shows a single Save action on an already-published workflow
